**John D. Loudermilk** wrote "Turn Me On."

She includes "Turn Me On" on her 2002 debut studio album *Come Away With Me*, and she also has an official live release titled "Live From Austin, TX" (released September 2008 by Blue Note/New West).

2. **The Songwriter**: "Turn Me On" was originally written by **John D. Loudermilk**. It was first recorded and released by Mark Dinning in 1961, though it gained renewed popularity through notable cover versions including Norah Jones' version from her 2002 album.
